stem: What was the policy of Indian National Congress during II World War? nd

options.label: a
options.text: Cooperation of Britain in the case of assurance of Complete Independence.

expl: When World War II broke out in 1939 A.D., Britain made India belligerent without consulting Indian elected councils and also declared the Emergency. That action angered Indian offi cials and prompted the Congress Party to declare that India would not support the war until it had been granted complete independence.

stem:
Assertion (A) :The Congress Ministries in all the provinces resigned in the year 1939.
Reason (R) : The Congress did not accept the decision of the Viceroy to declare war against Germany in the context of the Second World War.
Code:

expl: On September 3, 1939 A.D. Lord Linlithgow declared India in the war against Germany. Congress cabinets had resigned from all the provinces for declaring war without the consent of the Congress Ministries. Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

stem: The Congress Ministries in all the provinces resigned in the year 1939, because : (a) Congress was unable to make a cabinet in other four provinces. (b) The rise of the left wing of Congress made impossible to work for the cabinet. (c) There was too much communal turbulence in the provinces (d) None of the above is true from the given statement
expl: After 28 months of tenure, the cabinets of Congress resigned in 1939 A.D. because British Government had declared India as a war-torn country without the consent of Indians. Thus, option (d) is true.

stem: When did the II World War end? nd
expl: The Second World War commenced on September 1, 1939 A.D. with the invasion of Germany over Poland which ended after six years in 1945 A.D.

stem: Who was the British Prime Minister of Britain during the Second World War?
expl: Among the given options Winston Churchill was the Prime Minister of Britain during IInd World War. His tenure was from 1940-45 and 1951-55.
